result.detail: Zoho docs: register a "server-based app" in the API console and get a client ID and secret. Server-based apps are meant for multiple Zoho accounts, and users grant access via OAuth. I read the register-client, register-app and server-based-apps overview pages. None mention app review, verification, approval or a cap on users/installs/orgs. Marketplace listing is a separate, optional path. I did not find an explicit statement on unverified-app limits, so "none" rests on the absence of any documented gate.
result.quote: Applications that are intended for use by multiple Zoho accounts.
